g.text: Finite motion · execution, controlled stop and lease loss
[UI owner keepalive · every 50 ms while active]
One renewal request in flight; late renewals do not revive expired jobs.
Ownership renewal is separate from M4 pulse-schedule maintenance.
[M4 execution worker · notifications + up to 1 ms timed wait when active]
The installed schedule already contains its brake.
Continuing motion replaces future data before that boundary.
Stopping does not need a new M7 plan.
Controlled stop · two ways to select the installed brake
No reply from M7 is needed for this local selection.
A disconnected UI cannot infer a confirmed physical stop.
Natural completion follows the same result path with Completed.
Communication failure can leave the UI result Unknown.
Local faults / explicit Abort bypass braking and may invalidate references.
Hardware-guard cessation is not a controlled-stop guarantee.
Starts with a prepared, running Executor program. Raw motor stops and homing use a different path.
Configured timing is shown, not a measured worst-case guarantee. Source-level behavior still needs full hardware qualification.
